newsitem.title: FRANCE: RUGBY UNION-ASPIRING ITALY MEET FIVE NATIONS CHAMPIONS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ASPIRING ITALY MEET FIVE NATIONS CHAMPIONS.

text.p: Italy face depleted Five Nations grand slam champions France on Saturday seeking a victory which would greatly enhance their claims for inclusion in the northern hemisphere's senior competition.
The Italians have won one and lost three of their encounters with the other Five Nations teams this season.
The win came in Dublin in January when they beat Ireland 37-29 but they lost only narrowly to Wales, 31-22 in Rome, and to Scotland, 29-22 at Murrayfield.
Their one major blip came against England at Twickenham when they were beaten 54-21 but in all four matches they confirmed their growing reputation for good, open rugby.
Italy's last meeting with France in the inaugural Latin Cup tournament in Argentina in October 1995 ended in a 34-22 defeat.

The French are without half the team which clinched the country's fifth grand slam with victory over Scotland at Parc des Princes in Paris last Saturday. Two are at the World Sevens in Hong Kong, the others have club commitments or are nursing injuries.
The match is the first international for World Cup captain Philippe Saint-Andre, who needed surgery on a groin injury, since he played in a win over Wales in Cardiff in September.
But, in the absence of grand slam captain Abdelatif Benazzi, fellow back-row forward Fabien Pelous has been given the captain's armband to allow Saint-Andre to concentrate on his game.
"It's normal," Saint-Andre said. "I'm just coming back to competition."

France - 15-Jean-Luc Sadourny; 14-Stephane Ougier, 13-Yann Delaigue, 12-Pierre Bondouy, 11-Philippe Saint-Andre; 10-David Aucagne, 9-Guy Accoceberry; 8-Fabien Pelous (captain), 7-Philippe Benetton, 6-Arnaud Costes, 5-Hugues Miorin, 4-Olivier Merle, 3-Franck Tournaire, 2-Marc Dal Maso, 1-Marc de Rougemont.

Italy - 15-Javier Pertile; 14-Paolo Vaccari, 13-Stefano Bordon, 12-Ivan Frencescato, 11-Marcello Cuttita; 10-Diego Dominguez, 9-Alessandro Trocon; 8-Julian Gardner, 7-Andrea Sgorlon, 6-Massimo Giovanelli (captain), 5-Giambattista Croci, 4-Walter Cristofoletto, 3-Franco Properzi, 2-Carlo Orlandi, 1-Massimo Cuttita.
